title: Parallel WO snapshots stay ordered and interrupted active steps retain unknown final spend
steps: Run the real chain engine snapshot ordering reproduction and interrupted cost projections without models or paid services.
expect: A delayed older brand snapshot cannot overwrite the running parallel planner.
Interrupted active steps leave totalUsd null and retain knownUsd without rewriting original chain measurements.
Completed numeric measurements, live elapsed time and settlement bounds retain their existing semantics.

tests: a late brand progress write cannot erase the running parallel planner
an interrupted planner retains measured spend as a subtotal and leaves its final cost unknown
running and completed chains retain their existing timing and verdicts
Ops preserves historical measured numeric totals and genuine zero costs
